title: A 345-follower account is the subject of "TWITTER PORTRAITS #12" and says thanks
summary: On Mon 16 Nov 03:24Z @norvid-studies.bsky.social posted "TWITTER PORTRAITS #12 @yhjet.bsky.social" with a link to a post on Substack (10 likes). Four minutes later @yhjet.bsky.social (345 followers) quote-posted it: "woah ty norvid !!" (6 likes), and replied to that: "everyone go watch 'center jenny'". In the half hour before, the two accounts had exchanged several replies on other subjects. The portrait itself is on another site and is not in the digest.
